title: Lists, conditions and loops
scenes: Count the backpack slots
list preserves item boundaries. The words red apple form one item.
Find the second item
Indices start at 0, so the second item has index 1.
Repeat a job for each item
foreach puts each list element into item, then executes the script.
Let the gatekeeper choose
>= includes equality: exactly 10 coins can enter.
Add values using a loop
Start total at 0 and add the current number on every turn.

title: Procedures and safe calculations
scenes: Make a reusable skill card
proc defines a recipe, arguments supply inputs, and return gives a result back.
Use another input
Reuse the same procedure instead of copying its code.
Notice integer division
5/2 is 2. Use a decimal or double to preserve the fractional part.
Protect empty input first
Return 0 for an empty list to avoid dividing by zero.
Add, then divide by the count
The sum is 15. Dividing by 3 gives an average of 5.0.
Change the data to test the rule
Try {1 2} and {-2 2} to verify that the procedure is reusable.

title: One report, one chip adventure
scenes: Meet a simplified timing report
Each record contains a path and slack. Negative slack counts as a violation.
Separate a record's fields
lassign passes the record fields to path and slack in order.
Count violating paths
For each slack below 0, increase count by one.
Find the worst slack
Start worst with the first actual record and keep the smaller values.
Deliver the result as a dictionary
Another Tcl script can continue processing these results.
One last check before graduating
This demo uses nonempty input. Lesson 20 also requires an empty-report case.
